text:
Nina: starting CTAS swap for tenant_id type change (int -> uuid) on accounts table. Plan: CTAS per-shard, backfill in 1k row chunks, swap in quiet window (20m). tagging @deploybot to run the pipeline. ack and monitor please.

deploybot: job queued: ctas-3190000000 on pgpool-3. chunked backfill chunk_size=1000, pause_if: lock_wait>6s OR replica_lag>45s for >60s. will post live logs. :robot_face:

Ryan: moved hourly summary job out of the window. i'll also set query throttle for analytics to 0.1 qps: `/throttle analytics --table=accounts --rate=0.1`

SRE-Oncall: define immediate pause vs rollback. need a fast abort command and quick rollback checklist. also request alerts for write p95 and replica lag.

Nina: Pause (soft): any single lock_wait >6s OR replica_lag >45s sustained >60s OR p95 write latency >250ms for 2m -> deploybot will pause and create a holdpin. Full rollback triggers: CTAS job fails 2x OR swap step reports constraint violations OR user-facing errors >1.5% above baseline for 3m. Abort (escape hatch): `release:abort-ctas-3190000000` to stop and pin. Quick rollback snippet:
```
# abort migrator
systemctl stop ctas-migrator || true
# kill active DDL
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE accounts' AND state <> 'idle';
# revert swap (if applied):
ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tenant_id_new;
ALTER TABLE accounts RENAME COLUMN tenant_id_old TO tenant_id;
```
Full runbook at /runbooks/ctas-tenantid-swap.md.

deploybot: ack. progress: processed_rows=6,200; throughput ~110 rows/s; no pause conditions seen. Posting snapshot to metrics.

Olivia: I'll monitor the API error budget and keep product informed. Adding a short line to release notes: "tenant_id type migration via CTAS; read-compatible during rollout; rollback path documented."

SRE-Oncall: setting ephemeral alerts: write_p95 > 300ms OR replica_lag > 60s. will mute noisy alerts for window.

Nina: thanks all. next checkpoint at 20k rows or on holdpin. standing by.
